create_Message_dataclass: create a Message dataclass instance with a model, weight, and metadata fields for FL communication
populate_state_dict: call populate_state_dict on a Message to deep copy the model state dict into the message
update_model_: call update_model_ on a Message to load the stored state dict back into the local model
configure_Message_for_quantization: configure a Message with qparams and seed_centroids fields for scalar and product quantization
configure_Message_for_sparsity: configure a Message with sparsity_mask_params for sparse model updates in federated learning
